verdict.rationale: The agency's own pages say founders can apply for a business license online, which takes about 10 business days compared with up to six weeks by mail, through a My DOR account. They also say businesses must report and pay B&O tax on the Excise Tax Return in MyDOR, with step-by-step help covering deductions, ACH payment, confirmation printing, drafts and amendments. The probe hit a login wall on secure.dor.wa.gov, which is expected for an authenticated portal and does not contradict these claims. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on confirmation that the online application and filing flows complete end to end.
